title: Offers, interior options, and service support
summary: This topic loosely combines comments about product offerings, interior and technology preferences, dealer support, and a few direct remarks on performance and cargo space.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise strong performance, design, safety, and acceptable utility despite wanting a larger trunk.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize incomplete diagnostics and the lack of a lasting repair for an audio problem.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention requested offers, interior colors, lighting, technology, loaners, dealer help, and charger availability without enough context to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: The cluster mixes several loosely related subjects rather than one clearly coherent issue.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the sentiment picture is limited.
Some fragments are too short or lack context to determine whether the customer is satisfied, dissatisfied, or simply making a suggestion.
